resolved_source_findings.detail: Suspension: GERD, EE and maintenance from age 1 year; EE only from 1 month to less than 1 year. Selected capsule: indication minimum age 2 years; subsection 8.4 has inconsistent less-than-1-year wording and 2.2 is absent. Used the explicit indication minimum age of 2; numerical pediatric doses remain suspension-specific.

Clarithromycin label regimens retained as labeled options with exact 10- and 14-day durations; not presented as preferred empiric regimens. ACG 2024 susceptibility and test-of-cure requirements included.
